comment: Resource budgets, see docs/adr/0011-lean-by-default.md. Raise a budget only in a PR that explains why. Baselines measured 2026-11-11 on commit d99655e. Initial JS lowered to 90 KB with lazy widgets, pages and catalogues (#116; measured 33.3 KB on 2026-11-12). Binary raised to 18.9 MB for the briefing, countdown and focus modules (#52, #54, #58; measured 18.0 MB on 2026-11-12). Image raised to 8.8 MB to match the binary budget (image is about 0.46 x the binary; measured 8.56 MB on 2026-11-13 after #183, #198). Binary raised to 19.5 MB and image to 9.0 MB for the immich, fuel, releases, game deals and habits modules (#184, #186, #187, #188, #190; measured 19.0 MB and 8.71 MB on 2026-11-13, roughly 0.2 MB per module). Binary raised to 20.0 MB and image to 9.3 MB for the mail, birthdays and photo frame modules (#283, #287, #286; main measured 19.3 MB on 2026-11-14 before mail; photo frame adds about 0.35 MB for the GIF decoder and JPEG encoder of the standard library). Binary raised to 20.5 MB and image to 9.5 MB for config as code (#88): go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 adds about 0.2 MB; main measured 19.7 MB and 9.2 MB on 2026-11-14. Binary raised to 21.0 MB and image to 9.8 MB for the wiki search module (#321) after calendar accounts (#282) and Slack/Teams channels (#324, #325) reached 20.5 MB and 9.5 MB on 2026-11-15; a size review is tracked in #358. piImageMB measured 2026-11-12 in the Raspberry Pi image workflow. extensionZipKB added for the local mode of the browser extension (ADR 0019, #291): measured 522 KB on 2026-11-15 with the app bundle, budget = measured + 10 %. Binary raised to 21.2 MB and image to 9.9 MB for the phone list module (#300) under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011; measured 21.1 MB on 2026-11-16. Binary raised to 21.5 MB without a new module: the core extension points for the organisation features added on 2026-11-16 (frontend plugins #441, branding with the generated app manifest #449, instance name #457, theme presets #459, calendar sharing #458, #463, Find for bookmarks and wiki #447) took the binary to 21.3 MB; the image stays within 9.9 MB. Initial JS lowered to 70 KB after the sign-in screen stopped pulling the auth settings and the QR code library into the entry chunk: measured 75.8 KB before and 59.2 KB after on 2026-11-16. Extension zip raised to 610 KB: the app bundle in the extension grew with the search palette features of 2026-11-16 (time and date answers, tools, app commands, bangs, timers, own keywords; #472) and measured 580 KB with own keywords (#478); budget = measured + about 5 %. Binary raised to 21.7 MB and image to 10.0 MB for the two bundled typefaces (#504): 112 KB of WOFF2 that is already compressed; the binary measured 21.55 MB with them on 2026-11-16, and the browser fetches a font only when a theme uses it. Binary raised to 21.8 MB and image to 10.1 MB without a new module for linked sign-ins (#527, #528) and signing in with Microsoft by code (#535): own code on the existing OpenID client, no new dependency; measured 21.7 MB and 10.05 MB on 2026-11-17. Binary raised to 22.4 MB and image to 10.3 MB for the demo showcase (#549): the example fixtures, sample exports and demo seeders are part of every build because demo mode is a runtime switch of the same image; measured 22.0 MB and 10.2 MB on 2026-11-18. Idle memory is measured on a regular instance from #549 on: the demo now runs every widget with example data and no longer shows what users run. Binary raised to 22.6 MB and image to 10.4 MB for the Grafana module (#574) and the smart search answers on the server (#575, #577) under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011: own code, no new dependency; measured 22.5 MB and 10.4 MB on 2026-11-20. Extension zip raised to 640 KB: the app bundle in the extension grew with the Grafana widgets and texts and measured 617 KB on 2026-11-20; budget = measured + about 4 %. Binary raised to 22.8 MB and image to 10.5 MB for widget sizes and compact views (#595, #594): compact states of the services, backup, drive health and calendar modules and the widget size column, own code without a new dependency; measured 22.6 MB and 10.5 MB on 2026-11-21. Extension zip raised to 670 KB: the bundle holds every chunk of the web app, also those the local mode never loads, and with the settings start page (#600), saved places (#591) and the attention page (#592) it measured 643 KB on 2026-11-21; budget = measured + about 4 %. Binary raised to 22.9 MB and image to 10.6 MB for the places module (#591) and the attention list with its status reporters (#599, #592) under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011: own code, no new dependency; the image measured 10.5 MB on 2026-11-21 and sat at its budget. Extension zip raised to 700 KB for size previews and quick actions in compact views (#596, #598), which add to every chunk the bundle carries; budget = the 670 KB before + about 5 %. Extension zip raised to 715 KB and image to 10.8 MB for the settings search (#601), the advanced switch (#602) and Grafana values without the image renderer (#579): own code, no new dependency; the image measured 10.5 MB at its budget on 2026-11-21. Binary raised to 23.1 MB for the compact states of the Proxmox, DNS filter, WireGuard, weather and electricity modules (#641): own code, no new dependency; measured 23.0 MB on 2026-11-21. Binary raised to 23.2 MB for the setup assistants of the remaining integrations (#644, #645): error mapping and texts in the existing modules, own code without a new dependency; the branch measured 23.0 MB before the compact states above were merged. Binary raised to 23.3 MB for mDNS / DNS-SD in service discovery (#627): golang.org/x/net/dns/dnsmessage, a package of an existing dependency, and own code; it adds about 0.12 MB. Binary raised to 23.4 MB for signing in with Nextcloud and Home Assistant in the setup assistant (#654): the setupsignin module and token renewal in the smart home module, own code on the existing OAuth client without a new dependency; it adds about 0.08 MB to the 23.2 MB main measured on 2026-11-21. Binary raised to 23.6 MB for reading the FRITZ!Box, media server and fuel prices through named connections (#669) and the same for Nextcloud, Proxmox VE and Speedtest Tracker: own code on the existing connection resolver, no new dependency; measured 23.5 MB on 2026-11-21. Binary raised to 23.8 MB and image to 11.0 MB for the chore plan (#683) and the first-start flow (#671) under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011: own code, no new dependency; measured 23.7 MB and 10.9 MB on 2026-11-21. Initial JS raised to 70.5 KB for the place picker with the browser location (#693, #694): the location helper and the rounding it needs are shared code of the entry chunk and add 0.2 KB; main measured 70.0 KB on 2026-11-21. Extension zip raised to 750 KB for the widget help and the help answers in the search (#678, #698): the help texts of every widget kind and the dialog are part of the app bundle the extension carries; measured 720 KB on 2026-11-21, budget = measured + about 4 %. Initial JS raised to 72 KB for the help on every widget (#678): the help button of the widget header, the state that opens the dialog and the search hook are part of the entry chunk, the dialog and the answers load lazily; measured 71.3 KB on 2026-11-21. Binary raised to 24.0 MB for the family board (#685) and its help entry under the per-module allowance of ADR 0011: own code, no new dependency; measured 23.9 MB on 2026-11-22. Initial JS raised to 73 KB for the contracts widget (#687): the widget definition with its search keywords and the service registration are part of the entry chunk like those of every widget, the widget itself loads lazily; measured 72.2 KB on 2026-11-22. Binary raised to 24.1 MB and initial JS to 73.5 KB for the documents module (#688): own code, no new dependency, the widget definition and service registration are part of the entry chunk; measured 24.1 MB and 73.3 KB on 2026-11-22. Binary raised to 24.25 MB, image to 11.1 MB and initial JS to 74 KB for the meters module (#689): own code, no new dependency, and a shared bar chart component; the widget definition and service registration are part of the entry chunk; measured 24.2 MB, 11.1 MB and 73.9 KB on 2026-11-22. Initial JS raised to 75 KB for the connection choice in widgets (#709): the widget definitions pass the loader of the saved connections and the compact sources carry the choice, and the request helpers are shared code of the entry chunk; the branch added about 0.6 KB to main. Extension zip raised to 770 KB: the app bundle carries the connection choice of every widget kind and measured 754 KB on 2026-11-22; budget = measured + about 2 %. Binary raised to 24.3 MB for the search step of the onboarding wizard (#740): own code, no new dependency, the example list and the texts of the step are part of the web assets embedded in the binary; measured 24.2526 MB on 2026-11-22, main 24.2485 MB. Extension zip raised to 790 KB for the done page of the onboarding wizard with its setup walk (#751): the app bundle carries every chunk and measured 771 KB on 2026-11-23; budget = measured + about 2 %. Initial JS raised to 75.5 KB for the phone bottom navigation and the shared status dot (#770, #771): the tab icon choice, the navigation state and the dot sit in the entry chunk; main measured 75.0 KB, the branch 75.1 KB on 2026-11-24. Extension zip raised to 800 KB for the redesign of the widgets (#796): header meta, list rows, charts and the Tonight card change chunks the bundle carries; main measured 789.6 KB on 2026-11-26 and the server widgets branch 790.2 KB; budget = measured + about 1 %.
